note: Official GT compares the component 'type' string exactly, with the only documented leniency being box/ic and gnd/ground, v/vcc/vdd. Exporting 'resistor' where the GT says 'r' is therefore a type failure worth ~40 component F1 points on the public subset (measured), not a cosmetic difference. The spells below copy the published GT verbatim, including its typos (battary, transfomer, net_bidirection), because the comparison is exact.
applies_at: component export only; internal stage names (vbus_in, ...) are unchanged so network/label stages keep working

collapsed_before.reason: configs/baseline_v3.json used to send all three to vbus_in, which the official GT spells as three different types; those components could never match regardless of box quality

derived_splits.note: The deployed image only keeps the internal kind, so the split cannot be keyed by detector class there. adapter.refined_type applies these evidence-only rules at export time; measured +0.9 component F1 points on the six cached pages (TP 243 -> 246).

crystal.rule: pin count already attached to the component

vbus_in.rationale: net_input 323, pin 170, testpoint 43 in the public GT, so the majority spelling of each shape is the best available guess; testpoint cannot be separated from pin by geometry alone
